title: Pure B.E.S.
summary: B.E.S. monsters and their Boss Rush Spells, paired with generic staples and an automatic Extra Deck; the page's Rank 10 Train package is left out. Built around the 2026 support wave, the deck fields counter-laden battleships that protect themselves with B.E.F. Zelos and replace themselves through Boss Rush.

summary.title: Starters
points: Boss on Parade searches any B.E.S. monster on activation, and banishes itself from the GY to place Boss Rush from the Deck or GY face-up on the field.

B.E.S. Derringer Core reveals another B.E.S. in the hand to Special Summon itself with 3 counters, then removes 2 counters to either search B.E.F. Zelos / a Spell or Trap that mentions Boss Rush or revive a Level 9 or lower B.E.S. from the GY.

B.E.F. Zelos searches Boss Rush on activation, gives all B.E.S. monsters 500 ATK/DEF, targeting and effect-destruction protection, plus an extra counter on summon, and Special Summons a B.E.S. from the hand once per turn.

summary.title: Opening: Boss on Parade + Any B.E.S.
steps: Activate Boss on Parade to search B.E.S. Derringer Core (or Super B.E.S. Metal Slave if you already hold Derringer Core).
Reveal a B.E.S. in hand to Special Summon Derringer Core with 3 counters, then remove 2 counters to search B.E.F. Zelos.

Activate B.E.F. Zelos to search Boss Rush, use Zelos to Special Summon another B.E.S. from the hand with an extra counter, and send up to 5 differently named B.E.S. monsters from the hand/Deck to the GY to summon Super B.E.S. Metal Slave.

summary.title: Super B.E.S. Metal Slave & Name Spread
summary.text: Super B.E.S. Metal Slave Special Summons itself by sending up to 5 differently named B.E.S. monsters from the hand and/or Deck to the GY, entering with a counter for each card sent. As a Quick Effect on either turn, it removes a counter to destroy 1 face-up card the opponent controls along with 1 face-up B.E.S. monster you control. This list runs single copies of the classic ships (Big Core, Covered Core, Crystal Core, Tetran, and Big Core MK-2) to give Metal Slave five distinct names to send from the Deck.

summary.title: Fleet & Control
points: Boss Rush replaces any destroyed B.E.S. monster during the End Phase by Special Summoning a new B.E.S. from the Deck; its restriction against Normal Summoning barely matters because Derringer Core, Metal Slave, Big Core MK-3, Blaster Cannon Core, and Zelos all Special Summon.
When Super B.E.S. Metal Slave destroys one of your own B.E.S. ships to pop an opposing face-up card, Boss Rush triggers in the End Phase to replace the ship from the Deck.
B.E.S. Big Core MK-3 banishes itself from the GY to shuffle all other B.E.S. monsters from your GY back into the Deck, reloading the names for another Metal Slave or Boss Rush.
